title: ADIDAS ARENA
intro: A certain idea of the naming. When Adidas opens its first Arena in Paris, the brand pays tribute to the parisian youth via calling the venue their names.

title: THIS IS NEW RUGBY
intro: If football reflects society, rugby is far behind. Through our film, we wanted to showcase rugby as you never get to see it : the one played in the streets, the one that attracts new fans. In other words, the new rugby. The rugby everyone was waiting for.

title: BEYOND CEILING
intro: Through a young girl's journey, the film portrays the societal constraints that limit women's ambitions and achievements, unlike men who are often told from an early age that the sky is the limit.

title: QUAI 54
intro:
The BEST STREETBALL TOURNAMENT on planet earth.
This the main Basketball, Hip Hop & Urban Culture event.

title: SAISON XI
intro: For its eleventh edition, the final phase of the Impulstar tournament - a-5-a side football tournament for 14-16 year-olds bringing together teams from different parts of France - took place at the foot of the Eiffel Tower. The 16 qualified teams battled it out to be crowned champions in front of artists, athletes, influencers, media and sports consultants - in the middle of an exceptional ephemeral arena decked out in the colours of Instagram.

title: SNS – PARIS FOOTBALL WEEK
intro: WAY celebrated Fashion Week and the Euro Cup for SNS by unveiling the adidas Originals x SNS Football collection with a unique Parisian event, featuring a football field catwalk, a showroom, engaging activations for 600 guests, and a sold-out aftershow with multiple DJ sets.

title: THIS IS NEW RUGBY @FLAGSHIP
intro: Facade design for the adidas store on the Champs Elysées to celebrate the arrival of the Rugby World Cup and showcase the entire adidas athlete roster on the most beautiful avenue in the world.

title: EUROLEAGUE – OFF COURT
intro: Euroleague Basketball and Turkish Airlines decided to set foot in Paris and chose We Are Young agency to lead the design and production of an experience that sent fans to 7th heaven ! The agency developed a light, airy scenography that gives the impression of playing basketball in the clouds. The 100% immersive scenography was the setting for some cutting-edge basketball in all its forms: games of 2-on-2, 1-on-1, a dunk contest and wheelchair basketball set the pace for the day, which ended with a high-flying show by The RopeStylers !

title: UCL
intro: During the 2022 Champion’s League, Adidas and We Are Young agency organized a “Grand Paris” finale with football communities from every department in the Paris county. The 360 campaign shedded light on the 3 stripes brand’s partnership with UEFA, the Real Madrid soccer team and the city of Saint-Denis.

title: RED HOUSE
intro:
Radar affirms his involvement in street culture by taking up the codes of typical illegal hip-hop parties and brings together the major actors of the urban scene.
It is at la Station Nord, a famous place of the Parisian scene that desperados RED made his 600 guests dance on the music of rookies, the Mix of collectives ISKABA and FAMILY MARABOUTAGE and enjoy an exclusive showcase of the rapper VALD !

title: BOSE x JAIN
intro: Bose x Jain season 2 collaborates once again for the release of a limited collection of headphones, earphones and speakers. A campaign co-created by the artist and photographer Fifou to unveil Jain's new graphic universe on social networks and in FNAC french retail shop.

title: MR. A
intro: For the launch of the collaboration of André Saraiva and adidas Originals, André was followed by a photographer, friend of his, around iconic places in Paris. They exchanged on his artistic inspirations, Paris, his life as an artist and the adidas collaboration. The afternoon ended at the Marais adidas Originals flagship, where André live painted the storefront and a launch party took place with one of André’s close friend, Pedro Winter as the DJ. The editorial was posted on the Confirmed app.

title: FEEL THE ALPS
typology: Event design, Creative content, Brand influence
intro: A week of immersive experiences and content creation, to introduce the Alps, the birthplace of Edelweiss beer, to 16 influencers from the APAC region. This 360° project was thought for the Feel The Alps campaign of the brand. This event inspired a multitude of content for the creators, widely shared on social networks and was also the opportunity to shoot the 2022 Edelweiss campaign. It was one of the best social engagement campaigns ever for the HEINEKEN Company group.

title: AVENUE MONTAIGNE
intro: For the opening of Henry Jacque's first store in Paris, avenue Montaigne, a launch party was conceived in two different parts : first, a cocktail reception at the store, with selective VIP guests, and gourmet dishes by Alain Ducasse. For the second part of the night, Henry Jacques privatized the Plaza Athénée bar while Heron Preston, as the guest DJ, brought the crowd together. People came together to celebrate this launch and discover this high perfumery brand.

title: CONFIRMED
intro:
Confirmed, the Premium Adidas app, wanted to celebrate their subscribers and offer them the opportunity to win a golden ticket, that would allow them to access all raffles for a month.
A mysterious pop-up store appeared overnight in the middle of Paris. The windows whitewashed ; the storefront painted blue and an Adidas confirmed logo on them.
Opening the door the guests would lose themselves in a minimalistic blue box with a LED ceiling, old TV monitors and CCTV cameras.
In the middle of the room a pedestal with a gold control knob on it.
As the guests would turn the control knob, the ceiling would start changing color & the TV monitors would glitch. When the guests would find the right blue that corresponds to the rest of the room, the golden ticket QR code would appear on the screen.

title: PARIS BASKETBALL
intro:
The very first Paris Basketball drop of adidas Originals was brought to life on adidas Paris' Social Media with the trap boss Gazo, through digital content (photos and reels) conceived and produced by the agency.
A launch which was supported by influencers seeding. Influencers that have a strong link with Paris Basketball.

title: GORILLAS x ALL STAR GAME
intro: Gorillas became, in 2022, the official partner of the All Star Game (by Gorillas), one of the biggest basketball events in France, on 12/29 at the Accor Arena, sold out. On the occasion, Gorillas stands out with a high quality stand, side events, and goodies & basket gifts delivered live by its loyal riders via a contest on social networks. All punctuated by an exceptional influence plan and contests.

title: MESSI GOATS
intro: The day after Leo Messi won his 7th Ballon d’Or, 7 golden goats statues have made a long journey all around Greater Paris to celebrate football and Messi with the local communities. A keyshot at the bottom of the Eiffel Tower has been shared all around the world and it was the opportunity for a take over of the adidasparis IG networks to amplify the goats’ journey in La Lucarne of Evry, the monde FC playground of Nanterre and Fresnes.

title: REEBOK x JUL
typology: Brand Influence, Creative Content & Shopper Experience
intro: Collaboration between the brand Reebok and the French artist Jul, a video and photo shoot was organized at Studio Provence in Martigues in order to immortalize the collection developed between the two thirds. Relayed on the social networks of the artist and the brand, followed by an influence and communication plan for personalities but also internally.

title: BOSE x JAIN
intro: Co-creation and executive production of the BOSE x Jain limited edition collection visual identity. Collaborating with Jain herself and photographer Fifou to give life to Jain’s graphic identity, online and IRL in the FNAC French retail network.

title: GO CRAZY IN FORTNITE
intro:
Who never dreams to face a player like Neymar Jr ? But let’s be honest, on a soccer pitch, we really talk about a dream. And what about a Fortnite island ?
With EPIC GAMES, we drew inspiration from the Brazilian player to create a Parisian « Hub » & an innovative gameplay « Crazy Arena » available on the Creative Mode for two weeks !
After a recruitment campaign, regular players faced Ney Jr on that new gameplay mode with numerous talents such as Doigby, LeBouseuh or Gotaga. An amazing clash, broadcasted on Gotaga and Neymar Jr Twitch channels and recorded from the French Monster studio with the two stars !

title: MON DRESSING SOUPLINE
typology: Creative Direction, Content Production, Social Media Publishing, Influence
intro:
Have you thought that Soupline can bring you both on fashion & sustainable paths ?
We did it for you. With “Mon Dressing Soupline” the brand creates a digital and virtuous activation based on a second hand eshop campaign, hosted by influencers on both IG and Vinted accounts.
More than just fashion and promotional, the “Mon Dressing Soupline” campaign cares twice : fight against fast fashion and redistribute all of the raised funds to Emmaus Alternatives association.

title: EN PASSANT PÉCHO
typology: Creative Direction, Content Production, Social Media Publishing
intro: Have you ever met Cokeman & Hedi ? Well, lucky you. Netflix asked us to handle those two characters to promote the new movie “En Passant Pécho”. As we were producing the official trailer, Cokeman,Hedi and the amazing bunch of guests thought we cannot be this traditional … that’s why they also hacked the Netflix FR IG account for a whole day. Dear Netflix CM, forgive us, but it was too tempting.

title: ZX x 13 BLOCK
intro:
Adidas Originals and 13 Block are pushing the limits of innovation thanks to ZX by creating an 8D version of the song Tieks, a preview of their first album.
Back on a unique collaboration which will allow their common audience to explore and feel the “oddly satisfying” much closer to Stavo, Zed, Zefor et OldPee.

title: 40 ANS COURIR
intro: Realisation of the 360 campaign for the 40th anniversary of Courir including the artistic direction creation, the production of a communication toolkit (40 sec movies clip, teaser, 2D contents, retail…) and the management of a national social contest led by fashion talents.

title: ZX x VALD
intro: Vald and ZX 2K Boost defy the laws of physics and weightlessness in an infinite fall. An advertising campaign available in pictures and videos to be deployed in outdoor advertising and throughout the adidas Originals digital ecosystem.

title: LA HAINE
intro: Realisation of the Reebok x La Haine collaboration 360 campaign, including artistic direction creation, toolkit communication production (30 sec movie clip, teaser, 2D content, retail...), influencer seeding kit and digital auction management, featuring RBK shoes autographed by Mathieu Kassovitz.

title: DRIVE IN RADAR
intro: The 1st ever rap music Drive-In in France, showcasing young talents from RADAR with famous artists from the urban scene, in front of 125 cars and 500 attendees & broadcasted live on Youtube.

title: BAPE_FR
intro: Creation of the new editorial line and publishing strategy of the @bape__france Instagram account through chronicles of Parisian hype, in collaboration with young players of urban cultures and the famous photographer Fifou.

title: GOOD GAMES
typology: Brand Influence, Shopper Experience & Creative Content
intro: Design, production and animation of the Citadium's gaming corner during the Christmas month, in partnership with Team Vitality, the most famous French E-sport team and Corsair, an E-sport computer Brand.

title: RADAR
intro: Musical springboard that allows young talents to share the stage with famous artists from the urban scene, in the biggest french festivals.

title: GRAND PRIX DES HEROS
intro: Production of the most recent PMU publicity spot at the Longchamp racetrack while creating the Hero Grand Prix with presentations made by Lady Marianne, Soldat Poilu, Apollo 11, Cheval de Troie, Rebelle du futur, Cléopâtre and Napoléon as well as a reproduction of the final race with stunt men in costumes.

title: PREMIERE VISION
intro: For the Fall/Winter 2019 edition of Première Vision, the trade fair chose the Circus thematic to decorate its Design Selection corner.

title: TAKE ON SUMMER
intro: Two-days event to mobilize, reunificate and celebrate the parisian basketball communities around two NBA stars, James Harden and Donovan Mitchell.

title: OFF-ROAD
typology: Brand Influence, Shopper Experience & Creative Content
intro: Welcoming the Levi’s consumers and the sports enthusiasts into the intimacy of a professional team during their preparation, competitions and celebrations, in order to highlight the partnership between Levi’s and AG2R La Mondiale Cycling team.

title: UNEXPECTED BEACH PARTY
intro: An unexpected beach party in the heart Of Paris to set the release of the new Undiz bath collection 2019.

title: DÖNER KEBAB
intro: An exceptional evening, in an atypical place : a kebab in Paris, to celebrate the release of the capsule collection "Foodista" Reebok Classic

title: TOUTÂNKHAMON
intro: Content creation for the " Toutankhamon : Le trésor du Pharaon" exhibition and production of a viral clip with an artistic performance for Clairefontaine’s advertising campaign.

title: TANGO ARENA

title: XMAS MARKET
intro: A PR strategy to launch the brand's Christmas collection based on an immersive and experiential party, plunging many influencers into a brand-orientated X-mas Market.

title: THE TIMBERLAND STUDIO
intro: A pop-up store dedicated to women where the retail environment has been transformed into a cosy Parisian apartment to make the customers feel at home and enjoy a new brand experience.

title: TANGO LEAGUE

intro: Organization of three seasons of Tango League’s Match day, the biggest street-football tournament in the world.

title: PLAYGROUND ZZ10
intro: Creation of an iconic multi-sport event to celebrate the heritage of Zidane and adidas in the city of Saint-Denis, 20 years after the French football team's first World Cup victory.

title: FESTIVALS
intro: An urban arena, a real party with experiences to gather festivalgoers and artists around the brand's street culture values and, especially, music.

title: BEER FACTORY
intro: A dedicated area to craft beer in festivals, providing a unique experience and paying tribute to uncommon beer references.

title: PATCH EDITION
intro: Pop-up store and launch party of the Desperados Patch Edition, co-created with the streetwear brands Tealer, Wasted and True Vision.

title: 24 HOUR BOXING

title: 24 HOUR TRAINING

intro: Bringing the Reebok brand campaign and philosophy to life through the production of movies and a 24 hour non-stop training challenge (Yoga, Boxing, CrossFit & Cycling) at the Paris S.D.S.

title: GLITCH

title: QUAI 54

title: PULSE

title: CHALLENGE MY GAME

title: PROJECT HARDEN
intro: Two days of co-creation in Paris supervised by James Harden to pre-launch his new adidas basketball shoe.

title: FRESH TOUCH
intro: In festivals, a unique experiential area to discover the Get freshness effect in an original and sensational way.

title: SUMMER BREAK

intro: Two days of cool entertainment for the launch of the Men Spring-Summer collection at Les Galeries Lafayette.

intro: A multisport tournament at the heart of Paris with a 150m2 digital tracking playground specially designed for the occasion.

title: BPM CONTEST
intro: Renewal of the visual identity of the show and accompanying the brand on its eight-date tour of the most influential French night clubs.

title: BARAQUE À LAMBICS
intro: A crafty and original area to immerse festival goers into the brand's epicurean and friendly environment.

title: TANGO LEAGUE

intro: The organization of second season of Tango League’s Match day, the biggest street-football tournament in the world.

intro:
Content creations with Veenom, Fuego and Dimitri Costes, disclaimed in a experiential corner, forecasting the capacity of the shoe to be able to
confront all universe and elements.
